observations: Singer sewing machine on a wooden table with a metal foot pedal.
The machine head is silver with a red and yellow sticker.
The table has a yellow ruler on the front edge.
The table base is stamped 'SUN PREMIUM' on the metal foot pedal.
The table shows significant wear and scratches on the surface.
The machine head shows paint chipping and wear on the sides.
The table is outdoors on a concrete floor.

claims.evidence: The table surface is heavily scratched and the machine head shows paint chipping.
The brand is Singer, which is American, but the origin of the specific model is not shown.

claims.claim: the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motor may be seized.
risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and the motor running.

risks.risk: The needle may be bent or the presser foot may be damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the needle and presser foot area.

risks.risk: The table may have structural instability or the pedal may be broken.
risks.proof: A video of the machine being operated with the pedal.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and the motor running.
Close-up photo of the needle and presser foot.
Photo of the underside of the table to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
